'''''Galaxy's Edge: A Crash of Fate''''' is a [[canon]] young-adult novel written by [[Zoraida Córdova]]. The novel is part of the [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge (media project)|''Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge'']] media project, and was published on [[August 6]], [[2019]] by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]]. An [[Galaxy's Edge: A Crash of Fate (audiobook)|audiobook]] of the novel was also produced.
